summary: An M top is the bearish inverse of a W bottom: only a neckline breakdown confirms the top, and the head-to-neckline height is projected downward from the breakdown location (PDF pp.47–48). Four weekly-chart cases demonstrate sloping versus horizontal necklines, initial and second measured-move targets, and small-risk short entries with stops on a neckline reclaim (pp.49–54). The number of target waves is contextual rather than automatic: compare formation duration, decline duration, subsequent structure, and whether another target would imply an unreasonable valuation; draw lines through the greatest number of useful points rather than mechanically preferring every wick (pp.52,54).

patterns.name_en: M top (double top), neckline breakdown and bearish measured move
patterns.structure: Two major highs separated by a pullback, with a neckline beneath the formation. The schematic has highs 100 and 110, approximate head middle 105, and a horizontal neckline 80; actual examples also use rising necklines. Measure vertically from the approximate middle of the head/high-connecting line to the neckline at that location, rather than substituting the neckline's later breakdown value (pp.47–51,53).
patterns.entry: Short when price breaks below the neckline and the M top is confirmed. The schematic entry is near 79.5 after breaking 80; weekly examples enter near 20.5, 17.5, 28, and 24. No universal closing-price or number-of-bars confirmation is stated (pp.47–54).
patterns.stop: Cover if price rebounds back above the neckline (站回颈线). The schematic pairs this with a 5%–7% stop; case-specific stops are 21.5, 18.5, 29.94 (the daily high of a high-volume long black breakdown bar), and 25.5. If resistance cannot be reclaimed, keep the short toward the applicable target (pp.47–50,52,54).

target.formula: D = approximate head-middle value H_mid − neckline value N_mid at the measurement location; target_1 = neckline value B at breakdown − D; target_2 = target_1 − D, if a second wave is contextually appropriate.
target.worked_example: Schematic: H_mid 105 − N_mid 80 = D 25; B 80 − 25 = target_1 55; 55 − 25 = target_2 30 (p.48). 华纸: 29 − 18.1 = 10.9, then 20.9 − 10.9 = 10 (p.49). 仁宝: 26.5 − 18.1 = 8.4, then 18.1 − 8.4 = 9.7 (p.50). 中钢: 33.9 − 26.2 = 7.7; 29 − 7.7 = 21.3; 21.3 − 7.7 = 13.6 (pp.51–52). 永光: 29.9 − 19.9 = 10; 24.4 − 10 = 14.4 (p.53). These are the author's approximate measurement values, not silently recalculated averages of exact chart peaks.

confirmation: Neckline breakdown confirms the M; the broken neckline must remain resistance, rather than being reclaimed (pp.47–48).
华纸 and 中钢 are confirmed by a weekly long black candle breaking the neckline; 中钢's selected stop is the daily high-volume breakdown candle high (pp.49,51–52).

One versus two targets depends on head size/duration and how quickly the first target is reached, then the consolidation structure and reasonable price level; 中钢's roughly year-long formation reached its first target in about one and a half months (p.52).

For line drawing, prefer the straight line connecting more points. Wick highs or body upper edges can be used; lows are treated the same way. This changes target size somewhat without changing the overall structure (p.54).
invalidation: A rebound above the neckline triggers the short stop (pp.47–50,52,54).
Do not mechanically extrapolate indefinitely: a third downside target for otherwise stable, good-quality 中钢 is described as an unreasonable price (p.52).
timeframes: Daily candle high used for 中钢 stop placement (p.52)

rules.rule: An M top is the reverse of a W bottom and uses the same measured-move logic; neckline breakdown is needed to confirm it.
rules.quote_zh: M头为W底的反向，计算的方式是相同的。

rules.rule: Short on the confirmed neckline breakdown; stop on a rebound back above the neckline, otherwise seek the downside target.
rules.quote_zh: 因此跌破颈线空单进场，停损设在站回颈线时，反之，颈线站不回，看跌幅满足附近。

rules.rule: Project the head-to-neckline vertical distance downward from the neckline breakdown; measure the head middle, not necessarily the highest peak.
rules.quote_zh: 头部至颈线的距离＝跌破颈线后的等幅距离。

rules.rule: In the schematic, head middle 105 minus horizontal neckline 80 gives 25; breakdown 80 minus 25 gives the first target 55.
rules.quote_zh: 头部的中间值约105，颈线假设为平行线80，105-80＝距离25。

rules.rule: The second downside target subtracts the same measured distance from the first target.
rules.quote_zh: 第二波的跌幅满足直接从第一波跌幅满足再减等幅距离。

rules.rule: The schematic entry near 79.5 uses a 5%–7% stop associated with regaining the neckline and takes profit around the applicable one/two-wave targets; the author quotes approximately 30%–62%.
rules.quote_zh: 如空在79.5附近，设5%～7%停损，也是站回颈线之时

rules.rule: A rising neckline must be measured at separate positions: 华纸 uses 18.1 under the head middle but 20.9 at breakdown; subtracting distance 10.9 from the breakdown level gives target 10.
rules.quote_zh: 跌破颈线的位置约20.9元-10.9元＝等幅计算的跌幅满足10元。

rules.rule: 中钢 remained weak even at the first target during the financial crisis; its second target was 13.6 and it stabilized at an actual low of 13.7.
rules.quote_zh: 当年受2008年金融海啸影响，中钢达第一波跌幅满足仍无企稳迹象，直接掼杀两波。

rules.rule: 中钢's entry near 28 uses a specific daily breakdown-candle high 29.94 as the stop, about 7% risk; resistance not regained implies holding toward the two-wave target, for approximately 50% short profit in this case.
rules.quote_zh: 停损设在日线带量长黑破线高点反压29.94元，也是站回颈线反压之时

rules.rule: Choose one or two target waves by comparing formation scale/duration with the duration of the move and observing the subsequent consolidation structure; a large formation reaching its first target rapidly need not end there.
rules.quote_zh: 涨跌幅满足看一波或两波，看头部或底部的规模及进行的时间做对比，也可做判断

rules.rule: Do not extrapolate a third target when the resulting valuation is unreasonable for a financially stable, good-quality company.
rules.quote_zh: 若要再算第三波对稳健绩优的中钢而言，价位已属不合理，这些都是考量的因素。

rules.rule: 永光's short entry near 24 has a stop near 25.5 on a neckline reclaim, about 6% risk; cover around the measured target for approximately 40%.
rules.quote_zh: 停损可设在25.5元附近风险约6%，空头看反压，反压站不回看满足

rules.rule: For deciding whether to include wicks, draw the straight line that connects the greater number of points: more connections increase precision and structural completeness.
rules.quote_zh: 记住一个观念点多为主，越多点所连起来的一直线，精准度越高，结构也越完整。

rules.rule: Wicks and body boundaries are both legitimate line anchors; small resulting target differences do not change the structure. Apply the same point-count principle to lower wicks.
rules.quote_zh: 如永光周线，M头的两个高点，取上影线，也可取实体线上缘，一样是两个点，虽然影响到一些满足点的幅度，但不影响整个结构。

worked_examples.outcome: Illustrative breakdown, rebound after the first target, and continuation toward the second; not an observed backtest (pp.47–48).

worked_examples.period: 1993–1996; neckline breakdown marked 7/22 in the 1995 discussion; target vicinity February 1996
worked_examples.outcome: A weekly long black neckline break confirms the M in 1995; reached target vicinity at 9.73 in February of the following year, then based and recovered. Author proposes covering for about 50%.

M confirmed on 2000-08-05; actual low 10.17 was near (not exactly at/below) the calculated 9.7 target, then a stabilization rebound. Earlier 破底翻 is also labeled on the chart, but this page's trade instruction is the later M-top short.

worked_examples.timeframe: weekly formation; daily bar for stop
worked_examples.pattern: M头 with rising neckline; two downside waves
worked_examples.outcome: A roughly year-long top is confirmed by a long black weekly candle. The first target was reached about one and a half months after breakdown without stabilization during the 2008 financial crisis; decline continued to 13.7 near the second target before forming a bottom and rising.

worked_examples.period: 2009–2011; neckline breakdown 2011-02-19; entered target vicinity in early September 2011
worked_examples.outcome: Reached the 14.4 target vicinity in early September 2011, then formed a double bottom and recovered. The chart labels subsequent lows 13.13 and 11.93; the prose recommends covering near target rather than waiting for the ultimate low.

quantifiable: [pp.47–48] Candidate M detector: two major swing highs separated by a pullback, neckline beneath the head; a downward crossing of that neckline confirms a short. Swing selection and whether confirmation requires a close must be explicit implementation choices, not claimed as specified by the book.
[pp.48–51,53] Store neckline N(t) as a line. Measure D = H_mid − N(t_mid), then target_1 = N(t_break) − D; target_2 = target_1 − D. Do not replace N(t_mid) by N(t_break) for rising necklines.
[pp.47–50,52,54] After entry, test for a neckline reclaim as the structural stop; preserve case-specific price stops and the stated approximate risk percentages separately.

[p.52] Record formation duration and elapsed time to first target as inputs to a discretionary second-wave assessment. The example ratio is about one year of formation versus one and a half months to first target, not a prescribed numerical threshold.
[p.54] A possible implementation of 点多为主 is to score candidate wick/body lines by number of touches within a defined tolerance; the touch tolerance and tie-breaker are developer choices.
ambiguities: [pp.47–48] '跌破' and '站回' are not universally specified as intrabar events, closes, or sustained closes. Do not assert an exact close-only confirmation rule.

[pp.48–54] The generic 5%–7% stop and the neckline reclaim criterion are both stated, but no priority is given when percentage and structural stops disagree; several case studies use specific nearby resistance prices.

[pp.49–51,53–54] 'Head middle' is approximate and may be read from a connecting line: exact chart peaks (25.50/32.91; 26.85/26.37; 33.20/34.73; 27.68/32.31) do not always average exactly to the author's 29, 26.5, 33.9, and 29.9. Preserve the author's measured values instead of imposing an exact arithmetic average.

[pp.52,54] Duration, structure, company quality, and reasonable valuation guide the number of waves, but there are no quantitative thresholds. Wick/body choice is similarly contextual; a point-count tolerance and tie-break rule are unstated.

[pp.49–50,53] Target satisfaction is described as '附近', with no distance tolerance. 仁宝's low 10.17 is above its target 9.7; 永光 continues below its target before completing a double bottom. Target vicinity does not mean exact touch or the final low.
[p.48] Author-quoted short profits are approximate: using 79.5 as entry gives about 30.82% to 55 and 62.26% to 30, rather than treating the printed 30%–62% as an exact accounting result.
[pp.49,51,53] Weekly labels such as 7/22, 8/9 and 2/19 are retained as printed; this unit does not specify a trading-calendar normalization or adjusted-price data protocol.
